entities.name: Nishang
aliases: Nishang, destroyer of the Sultai usurpers
entities.description: A former soldier of Silumgar's army dying of a wasting disease, who is resurrected as a sibsig and used by Sidisi's agent to poison the Sultai.

entities.name: Titsui
entities.description: Nishang's late second-in-command, a purple vulture-like warrior whose form is impersonated by a rakshasa; the real Titsui was murdered by a Sultai priest.

entities.name: Titsui impersonator
entities.description: A blue-skinned, four-armed rakshasa who impersonates Titsui and Sidisi to recruit Nishang and later controls his body through a piece of his soul.

entities.name: Sidisi
entities.description: Silumgar's undead naga vizier, whose vengeance plot against the Sultai and the tree Nishang is made to carry out.

entities.name: Silumgar
entities.description: The dragonlord who ruled the Sultai and whom the Sultai defeated; his loyalists still revere him.

entities.name: Dauna
entities.description: Chief necromancer of the Sultai who leads the ceremony for newly undead sibsig and stabs Nishang when the poison spreads.

entities.name: Teval
entities.description: The Sultai spirit dragon and judge of the clan, who watches over the ceremony.

entities.name: Kheru City
entities.description: A lively Sultai city of stone buildings, markets and waterways.

entities.name: Kheru Temple
entities.description: The temple built around a vast ancient tree and sacred pool where the ceremony for new sibsig takes place.

entities.name: Gurmag Swamps
entities.description: Swamps where the barkeep says a soldier can find rest.

entities.name: Sultai
entities.description: The clan that defeated Silumgar and now resurrects the honored dead as sibsig.

entities.name: Sibsig
entities.description: Resurrected undead of the Sultai, once prisoners made to serve, now an honored class.

entities.name: Sacred tree of Kheru
aliases: the sacred waters of the ancient tree
entities.description: The ancient tree whose roots glow beneath the sacred pool used to anoint newly undead.

entities.name: Wasting disease
entities.description: A disease that rots the body and mind, killing Nishang.

events.summary: Nishang, rotting from a wasting disease, rants in a tavern against the new Sultai order that makes sibsig an honor.
events.quote: They made being a sib an honor now and gave all our captives rest.

events.summary: The barkeep expels Nishang after his diseased arm grabs him and ends up thrown into the fire.
events.quote: "Get out," screamed the barkeep, "and don't you ever come back!"

events.summary: A glowing purple carp appears to Nishang on his houseboat, and he loses an eye as it binds his boat to it.
events.quote: That purple light extended to the boat, pulling it in close and binding it to the fish.

events.summary: Nishang's body falls apart in the swamp and he dies.
events.quote: He felt his head fall forward, the skin tear, the tendons snap

events.summary: Nishang awakens as an undead sibsig and meets what appears to be Titsui, who says Sidisi saved them both.
events.quote: I was wounded, mortally, but I was saved by the only one who may have loved our master more than us: Sidisi.

events.summary: Titsui explains the plan: Nishang will attend Dauna's ceremony for the newly undead carrying poisons from Sidisi in his new arm.
events.quote: Poisons gathered by Sidisi during her tenure of service to our master

events.summary: Sidisi appears and Nishang swears to serve, offering a piece of his soul to seal the pact.
events.quote: I will give anything and everything to bring back all that we've lost. I swear to serve.

events.summary: In Kheru City a woman crowns Nishang with a garland and kisses him, but his hot metal hand burns her and he apologizes.
events.quote: clutching the back of her arm, where Nishang's metallic fingers had brushed her, burned her.

events.summary: In an alley, Nishang doubts Titsui's story and learns that his friend was killed by a Sultai priest; the figure is revealed to be a rakshasa.
events.quote: revealing the monstrous form of a rakshasa beneath.

events.summary: Nishang helps a boy to his feet and realizes sibsig can feel and are like the living, but the rakshasa takes control of his body.
events.quote: The rakshasa was controlling him, totally and completely.

events.summary: Controlled by the rakshasa, Nishang marches with the sibsig into Kheru Temple, where Teval and Dauna preside.
events.quote: harkened the entrance of Teval, the spirit dragon, and judge of the Sultai

events.summary: Dauna addresses the sibsig and invites them to be anointed in the pool.
events.quote: join me as we anoint you into this glorious future!

events.summary: Nishang enters the pool and the poison from his arm spreads, killing hundreds of sibsig.
events.quote: the poison expanded, turning what was once tender blue a violent orchid.

events.summary: Dauna impales Nishang with a chained blade and hoists him from the water as the sibsig dissolve.
events.quote: a blade that had been shot through him and was now lodged in place.

events.summary: Nishang pleads that he has changed, but part of his soul remains in Silumgar's grip.
events.quote: But part of his soul would always be in the grip of Silumgar.

relations.note: loyal soldier of the old dragon-rule
relations.quote: I was a soldier, loyal to the one true ruler of this plane
I will be honored to deliver your vengeance.

relations.note: a rakshasa who takes Sidisi's form and carries out her plan
relations.quote: his form shifts once again to Sidisi
Dauna, chief necromancer of the Sultai

relations.note: spirit dragon and judge of the Sultai
relations.quote: Teval, the spirit dragon, and judge of the Sultai
This harkened the grand entrance of her chief necromancer.

relations.note: plots to kill the necromancers, sibsig and tree
relations.quote: to kill the traitorous necromancers that desecrate our Silumgar's legacy.
Securing it was Dauna, whose eyes burned with terror and betrayal.
